Benjamin, saw Fello is pushing hard on the agent-led iBuying solution after the $25M raise.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Fello needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
